card.title: You Owe Me the Chance
card.instruction: Treat a past sacrifice, concession, or missed opportunity as a debt that should now be repaid with a real advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I withdrew from last year's audition for you. I get first choice of songs now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to withdraw.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I made the sacrifice easy to receive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thanked you. And I've already rehearsed the only song we both know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take that one. You can spend tonight learning something new; I spent last year letting you be heard.
